title: Past Simple — Questions & Negatives
objectives: Use past simple — questions & negatives accurately in A2 contexts.
Understand form, meaning, and typical usage.
Produce short spoken and written examples.
canDo: I can ask and answer past simple questions and make negatives.

warmUp.title: Activate prior knowledge
warmUp.prompt: Before this lesson, recall what you know about past simple — questions & negatives. How is it similar or different from Portuguese?
reflectionQuestions: When do native speakers use past simple — questions & negatives?
Can you think of one example?

explanation:
Did + subject + base verb: Did you go? | She didn't come.

Wh- past: Where did you live? | What did he say?

Did is the same for all persons.

grammar.title: Past Simple — Questions & Negatives
grammar.rule: Did + subject + base verb: Did you go? | She didn't come.

reading.title: Past Simple — Questions & Negatives in Context
reading.text: Did you finish the report? I didn't finish mine because the internet stopped. When did the meeting start? It started at nine. Why did the client leave early?
